summary: The first request after startup no longer recompiles torch.compile'd helpers: the serving thread count is set before warmup
compatibility: No configuration change. Startup warmup now runs with the serving torch thread count.
details: Dynamo guards compiled functions on torch.get_num_threads(); the count dropped only after warmup and graph capture, so the first real request recompiled every helper compiled during warmup.
GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 TP4 on four DGX Spark (from #681): cold first prefill +1.03 s -> +0.22 s.
